terms.definitionEn: A conditional rule that applies style rules when an environmental condition matches.
terms.definitionAr: قاعدة شرطية بتطبق تنسيقات لما شرط متعلق بالبيئة يتحقق.

terms.definitionEn: An at-rule that groups style rules behind a condition on output type or viewport features.
terms.definitionAr: قاعدة at-rule بتجمع تنسيقات ورا شرط زي عرض الـ viewport.

terms.definitionEn: A design approach that starts with compact-screen defaults and adds enhancements at larger conditions.
terms.definitionAr: أسلوب بيبدأ بتنسيق الشاشات الصغيرة وبعدها يضيف تحسينات للشاشات الأكبر.

terms.definitionEn: The visible area of a browsing context used for layout and screen-based lengths.
terms.definitionAr: المساحة الظاهرة من سياق التصفح وبتستخدم في التخطيط ووحدات القياس المرتبطة بالشاشة.

terms.definitionEn: A property that caps an element's used width at a specified limit.
terms.definitionAr: خاصية بتحط حد أقصى للعرض المستخدم للعنصر.

terms.definitionEn: A viewport-relative length unit based on one percent of the viewport's width.
terms.definitionAr: وحدة طول نسبية بتساوي واحد بالمية من عرض الـ viewport.

terms.definitionEn: A viewport-relative length unit based on one percent of the viewport's height.
terms.definitionAr: وحدة طول نسبية بتساوي واحد بالمية من ارتفاع الـ viewport.

terms.definitionEn: A condition boundary where a responsive rule begins or stops applying.
terms.definitionAr: حد شرطي عنده قاعدة responsive بتبدأ أو بتبطل تشتغل.

terms.definitionEn: A layout that adapts continuously to available space instead of relying only on fixed dimensions.
terms.definitionAr: تخطيط بيتكيف باستمرار مع المساحة المتاحة بدل الاعتماد على أبعاد ثابتة بس.

terms.definitionEn: An image presentation that adapts to its container or chooses a suitable resource for the viewing conditions.
terms.definitionAr: عرض صورة بيتكيف مع الحاوية أو بيختار مورد مناسب لظروف العرض.
terms.example: img { display: block; max-width: 100%; height: auto; }

terms.definitionEn: A conditional rule that responds to the size or style of an ancestor query container.
terms.definitionAr: قاعدة شرطية بتستجيب لحجم أو نمط حاوية أب تم إعدادها للاستعلام.

terms.definitionEn: A property that sets a preferred ratio between an element's width and height.
terms.definitionAr: خاصية بتحدد نسبة مفضلة بين عرض العنصر وارتفاعه.

questions.question: When does this group of rules apply?
options: At widths of 48rem or more
When the viewport is at most 48rem wide
Only when the device is held vertically
Whenever the navigation receives focus
questions.explanation: min-width is a lower bound, so the condition matches widths at or above 48rem.
questions.explanationAr: min-width حد أدنى، فالشرط بيتحقق عند 48rem أو أكتر.

questions.question: Which layout is the default below the media threshold?
options: The grid declaration is always active
The cards use block layout
The cards are hidden
The cards use inline-flex
questions.explanation: The base declaration applies by default; the later grid declaration is conditional on the media query.
questions.explanationAr: القاعدة الأساسية بتشتغل افتراضيًا، أما grid فمشروطة بتحقق media query.

questions.question: What does max-width: 40rem mean for this condition?
options: The viewport must be wider than 40rem
The viewport's height is capped at 40rem
The viewport width must be 40rem or less
The menu itself must be exactly 40rem wide
questions.explanation: max-width sets an upper inclusive threshold for the viewport width condition.
questions.explanationAr: max-width بتحط حد أقصى شامل لعرض الـ viewport.

questions.question: What does 100vh represent in this declaration?
options: One hundred pixels of height
The width of one hundred characters
One hundred percent of the parent font size
A length equal to the viewport height
questions.explanation: vh is one percent of the viewport height, so 100vh corresponds to the full viewport height.
questions.explanationAr: كل vh واحد بالمية من ارتفاع الشاشة، فـ 100vh بيساوي ارتفاعها كله.

questions.question: Does this min-width condition match at the stated viewport width?
questions.explanation: 48rem is 768px at a 16px root size; 800px meets the lower bound.
questions.explanationAr: 48rem تساوي 768px مع حجم جذر 16px، وعرض 800px بيحقق الشرط.

questions.prompt: Apply these styles at widths of at least 48rem.
questions.explanation: The @media at-rule introduces a conditional group of styles.
questions.explanationAr: قاعدة @media بتبدأ مجموعة تنسيقات شرطية.

questions.prompt: Prevent an image from exceeding its containing block's width.
questions.explanation: max-width caps the image width while preserving its intrinsic ratio when height is auto.
questions.explanationAr: max-width بتحط حد أقصى للعرض، وheight: auto بتحافظ على النسبة.

questions.question: What does this common pair help an image do?
options: Fit within the container; retain ratio
Crop to a square at every size
Stretch to match the viewport height exactly
Ignore its intrinsic dimensions
questions.explanation: The width cap prevents overflow and auto height preserves the intrinsic aspect ratio.
questions.explanationAr: حد العرض بيمنع الخروج من الحاوية والارتفاع التلقائي بيحافظ على النسبة.

questions.question: What quantity is the vw unit based on?
options: The root font size
The viewport width
The parent element's height
The number of words in the title
questions.explanation: One vw is one percent of the viewport's width.
questions.explanationAr: وحدة vw الواحدة بتساوي واحد بالمية من عرض الـ viewport.

questions.code:
@media (max-width: 40rem) { .compact { display: block; } }
/* viewport width: 600px; root font size: 16px */
questions.question: Is the conditional display rule active at the stated viewport width?
options: false
Only for print
true
The condition is invalid
questions.explanation: 40rem equals 640px at a 16px root size; the 600px viewport is within that maximum.
questions.explanationAr: 40rem تساوي 640px مع جذر 16px، وعرض 600px داخل الحد الأقصى.

questions.prompt: Set this hero's width to 80 percent of the viewport width.
questions.explanation: vw measures a percentage of viewport width.
questions.explanationAr: vw بتقيس نسبة من عرض الـ viewport.

questions.prompt: Set a minimum hero height equal to the viewport height.
questions.explanation: vh measures a percentage of viewport height.
questions.explanationAr: vh بتقيس نسبة من ارتفاع الـ viewport.

questions.question: Which authoring pattern is shown?
options: Desktop-only base styles with smaller-screen overrides
A rule that applies only to printed documents
A fixed-width design without conditions
Compact base with a larger-screen enhancement
questions.explanation: The compact base applies broadly and a min-width condition adds a larger-screen enhancement.
questions.explanationAr: التنسيق الأساسي مناسب للمساحة الصغيرة، وشرط min-width بيضيف تحسين للشاشات الأكبر.

questions.prompt: Keep the image proportional while its width adapts.
questions.explanation: An automatic height preserves the image's intrinsic ratio as its width changes.
questions.explanationAr: الارتفاع التلقائي بيحافظ على نسبة الصورة لما عرضها يتغير.

questions.question: What is the purpose of this width expression?
options: Fluid width minus gutters, capped at 70rem
Always force the content to exactly 70rem
Set width to the smaller of 100 pixels and 2rem
Scale width only with viewport height
questions.explanation: The min() function chooses the smaller expression, limiting the fluid width while leaving an allowance.
questions.explanationAr: دالة min() بتختار القيمة الأصغر وبتحط حدًا للعرض المرن مع ترك مساحة.

questions.prompt: Apply a compact-menu rule when the viewport is no wider than 40rem.
questions.explanation: max-width states the upper bound for the media condition.
questions.explanationAr: max-width بتحدد الحد الأعلى لشرط العرض.

questions.code:
img { width: auto; max-width: 100%; height: auto; }
/* containing block content width: 300px; image intrinsic width: 800px */
questions.question: What used width does the image have under these constraints?
options: 800px
300px
500px
100px
questions.explanation: The intrinsic width would be 800px, but max-width caps the used width to the 300px containing block.
questions.explanationAr: العرض الأصلي 800px، لكن max-width بيحده بعرض الحاوية 300px.

questions.question: What does clamp() do when the preferred value falls outside the limits?
options: It picks the preferred value without limits
It replaces the size with the viewport width
It bounds the preferred value
It always selects the maximum value
questions.explanation: clamp() bounds the preferred value by the supplied minimum and maximum.
questions.explanationAr: clamp() بتحصر القيمة المفضلة بين الحد الأدنى والحد الأقصى.

questions.prompt: Keep a heading between 1rem and 2rem while preferring 4vw.
questions.explanation: clamp() takes minimum, preferred, then maximum values.
questions.explanationAr: clamp() ترتيبها حد أدنى ثم قيمة مفضلة ثم حد أقصى.

questions.prompt: Give this video a preferred 16:9 shape.
questions.explanation: aspect-ratio supplies a preferred width-to-height ratio.
questions.explanationAr: aspect-ratio بتحدد نسبة مفضلة بين العرض والارتفاع.

questions.question: Explain a mobile-first responsive styling strategy.
keyPoints: Add enhancements with larger min-width conditions
Avoid assuming one breakpoint fits all content
Test layout behavior across intermediate widths
questions.modelAnswer: Start with a usable layout for narrow viewports, then add enhancements with min-width media conditions as space becomes available. Choose thresholds based on where the content needs them and check the transitions between sizes rather than targeting only named devices.
questions.explanation: Responsive breakpoints should follow content needs rather than device labels.
questions.explanationAr: الأفضل اختيار breakpoints حسب احتياج المحتوى وتجربة المقاسات بين الشاشات.

questions.question: What are the benefits and limitations of viewport-relative units?
keyPoints: They can help create fluid sizing
Large screens can produce overly large text
Use constraints when unrestricted scaling is undesirable
questions.modelAnswer: Viewport-relative units can make dimensions respond smoothly to the viewing area, but direct scaling may become too small or large at extremes. Combine them with constraints such as min(), max(), or clamp() when the value needs bounds.
questions.explanation: Fluid units often need limits for comfortable behavior across sizes.
questions.explanationAr: الوحدات المرنة مفيدة لكن ممكن تحتاج حدود عشان ما تكبرش أو تصغر زيادة.

questions.question: How can CSS help images fit responsive layouts without distortion?
keyPoints: Use automatic height to preserve intrinsic ratio
Choose cropping separately when art direction requires it
CSS sizing does not itself choose a different source file
questions.modelAnswer: A common rule caps image width at its container and leaves height automatic so the intrinsic ratio is preserved. If the design needs cropping or a different image source, use an appropriate image technique rather than stretching the image with CSS.
questions.explanation: Sizing, cropping, and source selection are related but distinct decisions.
questions.explanationAr: تحديد المقاس غير القص أو اختيار ملف صورة مختلف؛ كل واحد له طريقة مناسبة.

questions.question: When might a fluid constraint be preferable to a fixed width?
keyPoints: A maximum can preserve readable line lengths
A minimum can prevent unusably narrow content
min(), max(), and clamp() express bounds
questions.modelAnswer: A fluid constraint adapts to available space while a fixed width can overflow or leave excessive unused room. Pairing flexible values with minimum or maximum bounds helps preserve readability and prevents extreme sizes.
questions.explanation: Constrained fluid sizing adapts while keeping useful limits.
questions.explanationAr: الحجم المرن المحدود بيتكيف مع المساحة مع الحفاظ على حدود مفيدة.
